Ricardo Almeida is a platform engineer whose work consistently elevates NexaGame Studios’ operational efficiency. His technical expertise in AWS cost optimization helped reduce our monthly cloud spend by 18% last quarter, balancing performance with fiscal responsibility. He designed a Kubernetes-based deployment pipeline that cut release cycles by 30%, and his Terraform modules for infrastructure-as-code are now standard across three teams. Ricardo’s Python scripts for automating PostgreSQL backups have prevented data loss risks during two critical updates.  

Beyond technical mastery, he thrives in collaborative environments. During a major game launch, he coordinated with artists and QA to debug server-side issues under tight deadlines, ensuring features met release targets. His REST API designs are clean, scalable, and documented thoroughly, making integration seamless for external partners.  

Ricardo’s reliability and curiosity drive innovation. He proactively introduced Redis caching, reducing database load during peak hours, and his Prometheus/Grafana dashboards now monitor 90% of our system metrics. His work ethic is unshakable—whether debugging complex load balancing issues or mentoring junior engineers, he prioritizes solutions over ego.  

Ricardo’s blend of technical rigor and teamwork has been instrumental in NexaGame’s growth. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. His ability to balance complexity with clarity makes him a rare asset.
